rows.resolution_note: Rule C, step 3 of the order of decision: sentence 2 of p001 (as given under this row, sentence 4 of the abstract) defines the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level genomic data by its procedure (one-sample MR, two-stage least squares), and the preceding sentence describes their Cox models on UK Biobank proteomic data; the other mention, CKD GWAS summary statistics derived from the UK Biobank, is a name alone and identifies no dictionary row, so no identifier conflicts.
rows.quote: Subsequently, we performed one-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) using individual-level genomic data from the UK Biobank and pQTL summary statistics from the UKB-PPP, applying a two-stage least squares approach.
